name: bipartite-graph
description: Bipartite graph store: items and categories, JSON write and query endpoints, pluggable storage adapters.

scripts.gate: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run api:check
scripts.api: npm run build && api-extractor run --local && api-extractor run --local -c api-extractor.memory.json && api-extractor run --local -c api-extractor.testing.json && api-extractor run --local -c api-extractor.llm.json && api-extractor run --local -c api-extractor.llm-testing.json && api-extractor run --local -c api-extractor.app.json && api-extractor run --local -c api-extractor.llm-anthropic.json
scripts.api:check: npm run build && api-extractor run && api-extractor run -c api-extractor.memory.json && api-extractor run -c api-extractor.testing.json && api-extractor run -c api-extractor.llm.json && api-extractor run -c api-extractor.llm-testing.json && api-extractor run -c api-extractor.app.json && api-extractor run -c api-extractor.llm-anthropic.json
scripts.dev:lab: bash -c 'source ./set-key.sh && npm run build && node dev/llm-lab/server.mjs'
